scope: offline source provenance audit only; no COM, no RF, no build, no flash

sdk_reference.note: external read-only input, not copied into Git

comparison_method.reason: ctx1_rx_admission_v25/radio_driver is stored with CRLF, dual_pan_mac_gate/radio_driver with LF; without normalisation all 94 files compare as different and the real delta is hidden

filter_c.detail: Both lines add the same '#if defined(DUAL_PAN_GATE)' override of nrf_802154_filter_frame_part at the same anchor (SDK line 39) with the same '#else'/'#endif' envelope at SDK line 476. The only difference is the callee: assoc_filter_part (V25) versus dual_filter_part (mac_gate).

v25_additional_changes: current_operation_terminate_traced with SUBMIT_HOOK / SUBMIT_RX_BUSY / SUBMIT_OPERATION_BUSY reason codes
ack_trace_wait and PHYEND-based ACK wait arming
core_c.merge_cost: zero; no core.c work is required for dual-PAN

only_in_mac_gate: separate rx_end_us / ack_start_us / ack_end_us / ack_address_us with validity flags

gate_stats_t per-context counters: ctx0_match, ctx1_match, foreign_reject, cross_pair_reject, malformed_reject, broadcast, ack_requested, ack_started, ack_completed, ack_deadline_miss, rx_drop, crc_error
gate_events_h.required_v26: union: mac_gate instrumentation and per-context statistics plus V25 CRC snapshot and cutoff drain; ring stays 32 because dual traffic roughly doubles the RX rate

consequence_for_plan.real_work_location: application layer only: two-entry context configuration with atomic commit, V25 deep admission predicate parametrised by context, per-context ACK gating, one-radio TX scheduler, host dual-store accessor
consequence_for_plan.superseded_assumption: the plan's earlier framing of 'merging two firmware lines' overstated the driver work; the Nordic driver needs no dual-PAN specific change beyond selecting the filter callee
